decks.itemPressed.description: Runs when someone presses a button on one of your decks, which are web pages of buttons you open on a phone or tablet. Good when one button should do a few things.

fields.deck: Only react to buttons on this deck, by its name. Leave empty for any deck.
fields.item: Only react to this button, by its name. Leave empty for any button.

variables.deckItemName: The name of the button that was pressed
variables.deckItemState: The button's look now: 0 normal, 1 active
variables.deckPage: Which page of the deck it was on, counting from 0

remote.signal.description: Runs when another Cuebot sends you a signal, which is a named message. Lets a second computer start things on this one, like a studio PC and a gaming PC.

fields.signalName: Only react to a signal with this name, like "go-live". Leave empty to react to every signal.
fields.instance: Which other Cuebot, by the name you gave it in the Remote instances list on the Servers page. Leave empty to react to any.

variables.signalSender: The name of the action that sent it
variables.instanceName: The name of the other Cuebot
variables.instanceLabel: The name you gave it in your settings

remote.connected.description: Runs when another Cuebot connects to this one, or this one connects to it. Useful to know the other computer is ready.

fields.instance: Which other Cuebot, by the name you gave it in the Remote instances list on the Servers page. Leave empty to react to any.

variables.instanceName: The name of the other Cuebot
variables.instanceLabel: The name you gave it in your settings
variables.direction: outgoing if this Cuebot connected to the other one, incoming if the other one connected here

remote.disconnected.description: Runs when the link to another Cuebot is lost, for example when its computer is switched off.

fields.instance: Which other Cuebot, by the name you gave it in the Remote instances list on the Servers page. Leave empty to react to any.

variables.instanceName: The name of the other Cuebot
variables.instanceLabel: The name you gave it in your settings
variables.direction: outgoing if this Cuebot had connected to the other one, incoming if the other one had connected here

decks.notify.description: Shows a small pop-up message on every screen where the deck is open. Handy to tell someone on your phone that something happened.

fields.deck: The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required.
fields.title: The bold first line of the message.

decks.itemSetBackground.description: Changes the background colour or picture of a deck button.

fields.deck: The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required.
fields.item: The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button.
fields.color: A colour as a hex code like #FF0000 or a colour name like red. Leave empty to keep the current colour.
fields.url: A web link to a picture to use as the background. Leave empty to keep the current one.
fields.state: Which look of the button to change: 0 is its normal look, 1 is its second (active) look. A button can have more looks; use their numbers.

decks.itemSetIcon.description: Changes the little icon on a deck button, for example to show a check mark when something is on.

fields.deck: The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required.
fields.item: The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button.
fields.color: The icon's colour, as a hex code like #FFFFFF or a colour name. Leave empty to keep the current one.
fields.name: The name of a free icon from the Iconify website, like mdi:home. Leave empty to keep the current icon.
fields.url: A web link to a picture to use as the icon. If you fill this in, it is used instead of the icon name. Leave empty to keep the current one.
fields.state: Which look of the button to change: 0 is its normal look, 1 is its second (active) look. A button can have more looks; use their numbers.

decks.itemSetState.description: Switches a deck button to one of its looks, like its normal look or its active look.

fields.deck: The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required.
fields.item: The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button.
fields.state: The look to show: 0 is normal, 1 is the active look. A button can have more looks; use their numbers.

decks.itemSetTitle.description: Changes the text on a deck button.

fields.deck: The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required.
fields.item: The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button.
fields.title: The words to show on the button. You can use %variables%. Leave empty to clear the text.
fields.color: The text colour, as a hex code like #FFFFFF or a colour name. Leave empty to keep the current one.
fields.state: Which look of the button to change: 0 is its normal look, 1 is its second (active) look. A button can have more looks; use their numbers.

decks.itemSetValue.description: Shows a small value in the corner of a deck button, like a counter or a score.

fields.deck: The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required.
fields.item: The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button.
fields.value: The text or number to show in the corner. You can use %variables%. Leave empty to hide it.
fields.state: Which look of the button to change: 0 is its normal look, 1 is its second (active) look. A button can have more looks; use their numbers.

decks.itemToggleState.description: Flips a deck button between its normal look and its active look, like a light switch.

fields.deck: The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required.
fields.item: The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button.

variables.deckItemState: The button's look now: 0 normal, 1 active

decks.pageNext.description: Shows the next page of a deck. After the last page it goes back to the first.

fields.deck: The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required.

variables.deckPageNumber: The page now showing, counting from 1

decks.pagePrevious.description: Shows the previous page of a deck. From the first page it goes to the last.

fields.deck: The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required.

variables.deckPageNumber: The page now showing, counting from 1

decks.pageSet.description: Shows a chosen page of a deck.

fields.deck: The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required.
fields.page: The page number, where 1 is the first page. A number that is too big shows the last page.

variables.deckPageNumber: The page now showing, counting from 1

remote.sendSignal.description: Sends a named message (a signal) to another Cuebot on your network, so it can react. For example, tell your second PC to start a scene.

fields.instance: Which other Cuebot to send to, by the name in the Remote instances list on the Servers page. Leave empty to send to every connected Cuebot.
fields.name: The signal's name, like "go-live". The other Cuebot listens for this name. Required.
fields.includeArgs: Tick to also send all the variables this action has right now. Untick to send only the ones typed below.
fields.arguments: Extra information to send, one per line as name=value, like scene=Main. You can use %variables%. These are always sent.

variables.remoteSignalSent: How many Cuebots received the signal

remote.waitForSignal.description: Pauses this action until another Cuebot sends a signal with a certain name. Only signals that arrive after the pause starts count.

fields.instance: Only accept the signal from this Cuebot, by the name in the Remote instances list on the Servers page. Leave empty to accept it from any.
fields.name: The signal's name to wait for, like "go-live". Required.
fields.timeoutMs: How long to wait, in milliseconds (30000 is 30 seconds). Use 0 to wait forever.
fields.stopOnTimeout: Tick to stop this action if no signal arrives in time. Untick to carry on with the next step anyway.
fields.overwrite: Tick to let the signal's information replace variables of the same name this action already has. Untick to keep your own.

variables.signalTimeout: True when the wait ran out of time
variables.signalName: The name of the signal that arrived
variables.signalSender: The name of the action that sent it
variables.instanceName: The name of the other Cuebot
variables.instanceLabel: The name you gave it in your settings
